data.name: Ganesh
data.gender_notes: Ganesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit gaṇa, 'host, multitude', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the hosts'. Its root is Sanskrit gaṇa + īśa. Ganesha, the elephant-headed remover of obstacles. Ganesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the ganas (hosts)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ganesh expresses “Lord of the ganas (hosts)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit gaṇa, 'host, multitude', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the hosts'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ganesh total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

vedic_reference.note:
Ganesha is a popular Hindu deity, the god of wisdom, knowledge, new beginnings, and good fortune.
He is the Remover of Obstacles, the Lord of Beginnings, the Giver of Knowledge, and the Destroyer of Evil.
